preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in stdin.split()[:1])
preconditions.description: The first integer n must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 2000 for x in stdin.split()[1:3])
preconditions.description: The second integer m must satisfy 0 ≤ m ≤ 2000.
The input must contain exactly n + 2 + 2*m lines.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[3:3+n])
preconditions.description: Each part's energy value vi must satisfy 0 ≤ vi ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in [int(stdin.split()[3 + 2*i + j]) for i in range(m) for j in range(2)])
preconditions.description: Each rope connects two parts xi and yi where 1 ≤ xi, yi ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(int(stdin.split()[3 + 2*i]) != int(stdin.split()[3 + 2*i + 1]) for i in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each rope connects two distinct parts (xi ≠ yi).

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum total energy.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == min(sum(v[i] for i in permutation if all(j not in permutation[:permutation.index(i)] for j in neighbors[i])) for permutation in permutations(range(n)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total energy required to remove all parts, where the energy for removing part i is the sum of vi and the energy values of all its directly connected neighbors that have not been removed yet.
